What it does: How many copies grow per square unit where the coverage is full. Trees might use 0.02, and grass 2.
The copies' size. 1 is the model's own size.
How much the copies' sizes vary, as a share. 0.2 means up to 20 percent larger or smaller.
The gentlest slope the asset grows on, in degrees. 0 is flat ground.
The steepest slope the asset grows on, in degrees. Trees might stop at 35, while rocks can sit on steeper ground.
How far above the ground each copy stands. A negative number sinks it into the ground, which helps rocks look settled.

0 to grow where the Foliage brush paints the asset. 1 to 4 to grow wherever that material layer is painted on the ground, as much as it is painted, so painting the ground Grass grows grass. With a layer chosen, the painted coverage is ignored.
